details.description: OpenHermes-2.5-Mistral-7B is a 7-billion-parameter chat model created by Teknium, fine-tuned from Mistral-7B-v0.1 and described on its model card as "a continuation of OpenHermes 2". It was trained on roughly 1 million entries of primarily GPT-4-generated instruction data plus curated open-source datasets, with 7-14% of that data focused on code, which the card says unexpectedly improved several non-code benchmark scores too. It uses ChatML-formatted multi-turn conversations compatible with the OpenAI chat-endpoint structure and is licensed under Apache 2.0.
advantages: Scores 73.12 average on the GPT4All benchmark suite, per the model card.
Scores 50.7% pass@1 on HumanEval, per the model card.
Adding roughly 7-14% code-instruction data to training unexpectedly improved several non-code benchmark scores, per the model card.
disadvantages: The model card lists English as the only supported language.

notes: Fireworks' page confirms the mapping to teknium/OpenHermes-2.5-Mistral-7B and matches the catalog's 32768-token max_input/max_output (Fireworks states 32.7k). No mention on the model card of this model being superseded or deprecated.
